name: Minnesota Environment and Natural Resources Trust Fund (LCCMR)
program: Environment and Natural Resources Trust Fund annual proposals (Request for Proposal, M.L. cycle)
collect_note: Reads the LCCMR Proposal and Funding Process hub twice a day for its per-cycle process pages; a yearly Request for Proposal is issued each January and its cycle page is listed there as M.L. 20xx Process. The 2027 cycle is closed (proposals were due March 18, 2026), and the hub lists no 2028 cycle yet, so no item is produced until the M.L. 2028 Process page is posted. Items wait as candidates (auto_vet false) for confirmation on their own page. Grants and Funding Sources pages and the legacy RFP PDFs are not read.
